_comment: Tool-selection battery: real prompts + acceptable tool_ids. Run scripts/04_tool_selection_eval.py before and after any description/allowlist change. When a prompt misbehaves in the wild, add it here as a case — never fix it with a one-off prompt patch. Cases deliberately cover: list-vs-fetch-one, near-synonym tools, cross-package ownership (the wellcheck-style confusion), and free-form payload tools.
